XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Injector

  • Fault: Difficulty starting; once the vehicle has started, it runs normally

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty injectors

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the injectors; if necessary, overhaul or replace any that are malfunctioning or defective.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Problems with these components are quite common on this engine.
